payload.name: string — the sound's new name, trimmed; absent, unchanged; blank, refused
payload.file: string — the sound file's new path, trimmed; absent, unchanged; blank, refused
payload.tags: string[] — the sound's new tags, normalised per SoundTag@1: trimmed, lowercased, blanks and duplicates dropped, order kept; absent, unchanged; anything but a list of texts is rejected by tags-normalized
payload.volume: number — the sound's own volume in percent, 0 to 100, stored as a fraction of 1 to the whole percent; absent, unchanged; out of range or no number, rejected by sound-volume-range, never clamped
